rawContent: #ClimateChange  In the 2020 presidential election millennials will constitute the largest block of voters. They will vote in mass for the candidate with the best climate change plan, a candidate who inspires them. Lacking an inspirational candidate they will sit at home.

Time for debate is over #ClimateChange must be put in check by 2030 or else more people will die. Most of Western Europe India and China are planning on banning gas cars by 2030. The United States needs to have that conversation.
